Container.Name: medi
Container.Overview: medi is a self-hosted, hardware-accelerated media server for Unraid: a unified movie + TV library with a 10-foot TV client, Netflix-style hover previews, trickplay scrubbing, and on-the-fly HDR/Dolby Vision-aware transcoding via jellyfin-ffmpeg. Intel QSV and AMD VA-API run through /dev/dri; NVIDIA NVENC runs through the host NVIDIA container runtime. Point it at your movies share (mounted Read-Only) and browse from your TV.
Container.Description:
Self-hosted hardware-accelerated media server with a 10-foot TV client.
INTEL / AMD (QSV / VA-API): keep the "/dev/dri" device mapping below. That is all that is required.
NVIDIA (NVENC): set Extra Parameters to "--runtime=nvidia" (toggle Advanced View) and keep the "NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all" variable. You may remove the "/dev/dri" device if the host has no Intel/AMD GPU.
Volumes: /config is read-write appdata (SQLite library, previews, trickplay, HLS cache). /media is your library, mounted READ-ONLY so no scanner/asset bug can ever touch your files.
Updates: this image tracks stable releases on the "latest" tag. Use Unraid's "Check for Updates" (or the CA Auto Update Applications plugin) to update — a prompt means a new tagged release is out; your /config and /media survive the update. To track the bleeding edge instead, change the Repository to "ghcr.io/michelve/medi:edge"; to freeze on a version, pin a tag like "ghcr.io/michelve/medi:0.2.0".

Config.Name: Appdata (/config)
Config.Description: Read-write appdata: SQLite library, previews, trickplay sprites, HLS cache.

Config.Name: Media Library (/media)
Config.Description: Your movie/TV library, mounted READ-ONLY. Point this at your media share.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri)
Config.Description: Intel QSV / AMD VA-API render node. Required for Intel/AMD hardware transcoding; harmless to leave for NVIDIA-only hosts (remove if /dev/dri does not exist).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPUs to expose (NVIDIA hosts only). Also set Extra Parameters to '--runtime=nvidia'. Ignored on non-NVIDIA hosts.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: TMDB API key for artwork + metadata (posters, overview, cast). Free from themoviedb.org (Settings → API). Leave blank to run without online metadata. Used when Metadata Provider is 'tmdb' (the default).

Config.Name: OMDb API Key
Config.Description: OMDb API key, used only when Metadata Provider is set to 'omdb'. Leave blank for the default TMDB provider.

Config.Name: Metadata Provider
Config.Description: Metadata source: 'tmdb' (default, needs TMDB API Key) or 'omdb' (needs OMDb API Key).

Config.Name: Metadata Language
Config.Description: Preferred metadata language (BCP-47), e.g. en-US, fr-FR, de-DE.

Config.Name: BIND_ADDR
Config.Description: Address:port the server binds inside the container. Keep the port matching the WebUI Port mapping.

Config.Name: MAX_TRANSCODES
Config.Description: Optional: max concurrent transcode sessions. Leave blank for the auto default (iGPU ~4, discrete Arc/NVENC higher, software-only 1).
